pageDesc: Manage your profile, theme, language, and local browser data.
profileDesc: Update your display details for the demo environment.
demoProfileNotice: Demo Profile — changes are kept in local browser memory.
appearanceDesc: Choose your preferred color theme for the interface.
languageDesc: Select your preferred interface language and direction.
cvDocumentLanguageNotice: Application UI supports Arabic and English. Resume document content is strictly English & LTR only.
notificationLocalNotice: Preferences are stored locally. No browser permissions or emails are sent in this MVP.
prefProductUpdatesDesc: Show feature update announcements in studio.
prefDraftRemindersDesc: Remind me when unsaved changes remain.
prefExportRemindersDesc: Display PDF print tips when exporting.
privacyDesc: Overview of how your resume data is kept private.
privacyPoint1Desc: All drafts are saved exclusively in your browser's localStorage.
privacyPoint2Desc: No third-party tracking, advertising, or external analytics scripts are embedded.
privacyPoint3Desc: Analysis, matching, and text improvements run locally in your browser.
localDataDesc: Manage or clear local browser storage items owned by CV Platform.
accountDesc: Overview of your current demo session state.
demoAccountNotice: You are operating in a front-end demo session. Full cloud account syncing will be enabled after backend integration.
anonymousAccountDesc: You are currently exploring as a guest. All drafts remain saved locally.
clearCvDraftDesc: This will remove your current local CV draft from browser storage. This action cannot be undone.
clearSettingsDesc: This will reset your local settings and notification preferences.
clearDemoSessionDesc: This will sign out your demo session state.
clearAllDesc: This will erase your CV draft, local preferences, and demo session state. Only application-specific keys will be removed.
